description: This file defines an interface for URL generation within Drupal, extending Symfony's URL generator interface with additional Drupal-specific methods.

classes.name: UrlGeneratorInterface
classes.description: An interface extending Symfony's URL generator interface, adding Drupal-specific URL generation methods.

methods.name: getPathFromRoute
methods.description: Returns the internal Drupal path for a given route name and parameters.

methods.name: generateFromRoute
methods.description: Generates a URL or path for a specific route with options for absolute URL, query parameters, fragments, and more.
